## Data Source

This project uses historical Olympic athlete records spanning 120 years of modern Olympic Games (1896–2016), sourced through the [TidyTuesday Olympic Games dataset](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/master/data/2021/2021-07-27) (originally compiled on [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/heesoo37/120-years-of-olympic-history-athletes-and-results)). The data contains individual-level records for height, weight, age, country, event, and medal results.
